name: red-01-stub-accepts-everything
purpose: RED before implementation: an accept-everything stub validator and a stub CLI must fail the negative tests by assertion (not by a missing module): every rule test expects a finding and the CLI tests expect exit 1 or 2

notOk: the rule catalog is large, unique and uppercase
a packet built like revision 1 is rejected for guards, latency, the zero wording and the quota status
findings name a path that exists or is the missing field and are stable between runs
exit 0 and OK for the accepted fixture
exit 1 and one line per finding as CODE path: message
exit 2 for no arguments, an unknown flag, a missing file, bad JSON and a bad date
--help prints the usage and exits 0
a result file with packet and packetMarkdown is unwrapped and its markdown is checked
--markdown reads a separate file and --now overrides the clock; stale prices fail
--json prints the machine-readable result
a real process: exit 0 on stdin, exit 1 on a bad packet, exit 2 without arguments
DECISIONS_MISSING: one of the seven decisions is absent
DECISION_DEFAULT_NOT_NO: a decision that defaults to yes
ANSWER_SHEET_NOT_NO: an answer sheet that answers yes
ANSWER_SHEET_NOT_NO: an answer sheet with a chosen option
ANSWER_RUNS_NOT_ZERO: a default of one live run
PLACEHOLDER_REQUIRED: a subscription that is not an owner-supplied placeholder
PLACEHOLDER_REQUIRED: a tenant that is not an owner-supplied placeholder
APPROVAL_FLAG_TRUE: an approval flag claimed true
APPROVAL_ENVELOPE_NONZERO: a non-zero authorized spend
STATUS_NOT_PROPOSAL: a status that reads like an approval
UNIT_NOT_PROPOSAL: a cents unit stated as the ledger unit
CONSISTENCY_NO_C002_PINS: consistency rules that forget the C002 const 0 pins
REPO_STATE_MISSING: no state of the repository at HEAD
REPO_STATE_HEAD: a HEAD that is not a commit id
REPO_STATE_ARTIFACTS: a state section that omits the owner cleanup script
REPO_STATE_APPROVAL_CLAIM: HEAD artifacts presented as approvals
REPO_STATE_APPROVAL_CLAIM: an artifact row that is an approval
REPO_STATE_DEFERS: a packet that does not defer to the owner plan
REPO_STATE_ALLOWANCE: no relation between the allowance and the ceilings
REPO_STATE_QUOTA: no recorded quota failure
PRICE_DATE_MISSING: no price date
PREPARED_DATE_INVALID: no packet date
PRICE_DATE_STALE: prices fetched more than 7 days before the packet date
PRICE_STALE_NOW: prices older than 7 days at the injected date
INTEGRITY_MISSING: no integrity hash
INTEGRITY_MISMATCH: a changed field without a new hash
GUID_FOUND: a subscription-shaped GUID in a decision
GUID_FOUND: a GUID in the markdown copy
EMAIL_FOUND: an e-mail address in a risk
SECRET_SHAPED: a connection-string-like secret
SECRET_SHAPED: a GitHub token shape
SECRET_SHAPED: a long base64-like string
HARD_WITHOUT_PHRASE: the word hard without the planning-bound phrase
HARD_WITHOUT_PHRASE: the word hard in the markdown copy
MARKDOWN_HASH_MISSING: a markdown copy without the packet hash
MARKDOWN_CEILING_MISSING: a markdown copy that lacks a ceiling
MARKDOWN_REPO_STATE_MISSING: a markdown copy without the HEAD section
PACKET_NOT_OBJECT: a result is { ok, findings: [{ code, path, message }] } and never throws on junk

OPTIONS_COUNT: only two options
OPTIONS_COUNT: four options
